summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 passed. Verified mixed dark/green boot flicker, 221/221 green Ready settlement and shimmer, the full uncancelled cycle, exactly-once performAction logging, ignored transition/amber taps, single-tap red no-op, rapid double-tap red cancellation, immediate reactivation, color-blind mode OFF output, and clean console behavior. Production-style Expo web export also succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical defects found. Cancel is phase-gated to RED_ACTIVE, clears the pending red timer, and only restores runningRef after the green transition completes; performAction remains isolated to the red-entry callback.
The animated SVG wrapper now strips the invalid RN-only collapsable prop, and no console errors were observed across load, normal operation, cancellation, or immediate reactivation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used the explicitly requested Expo preview at http://localhost:3000 because this app has no backend or frontend .env. Boot sample at ~40ms had 144 dark and 77 green LEDs, then 221 green Ready with 131 opacity changes proving shimmer. Normal red began around 3.42s, performAction logged once, a single red tap remained active after 650ms, and Ready returned at 15.49s with 221 green. Double-click pair took 147ms and cancellation reached 221 green Ready in 1.006s with action count unchanged at one; immediate re-tap settled all 221 amber. Red opacities remained 0.85-0.999 with no strongly dim LEDs, confirming COLOR_BLIND_MODE=false behavior. Console error count was zero.
rca_of_the_issue: No product issue reproduced. One initial normal-cycle automation attempt failed because the test incorrectly expected aria-disabled='false' on an enabled React Native Web Pressable; enabled controls validly omit that attribute. The corrected assertion focused on actual clickability/status and the complete cycle passed.
